issues.quote: revenue rising 29.5% to $281.7 billion from $245.1 billion in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: $281.7B vs $245.1B is about 14.9% growth, not 29.5%. The 29.5% figure also contradicts the later claim that 15.5% net income growth 'slightly outpaced' revenue growth.

data.summary: Nearly all the figures are correct, but revenue growth is wrong: it was about 14.9%, not 29.5%. The margins, net income, EPS and R&D figures are consistent with Microsoft's reported results.
